Fusion instance, and th"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"e Fusion API is single-threaded — it may only be called
from Fusion's primary thread. So a plain MCP"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" server that shells out to Python
cannot work. This is a two-part bridge:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The MCP server runs as an ordinary DSH-spawned subprocess. The add-in runs

a `CustomEvent`, and executes them there."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Fusion 360 | A desktop install that can run add-ins — verified on **2705.1.15**. Fusion has no hea"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"dless mode, so nothing here works without the app running. |
